title: Ijwi ry'Ukwizera Guhishwe
intro: Mu mutima w'urukiko rw'igitugu, aho kutizera byari amategeko y'igihugu, umuntu umwe yagendaga mu mugozi ukomeye w'ukwizera n'ubwoba. Uyu muntu, wari hafi y'ubuyobozi bw'igihugu, yateze amatwi ubwo ubutumwa bw'umuhanuzi bwahuraga n'insuzugurwa n'iterabwoba. Igihe cy'ukuri cyarageze, bituma uyu muntu ahitamo hagati yo kwirinda bucece no kuvuga ukuri guteye akaga. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo muvugizi w'intwari?
clues: Nabaye mu rugo rw'umunyagitugu, nibonera ubwanjye ubwibone bwangaga ibimenyetso by'Imana.
Ukwizera kwanjye naguhishe, ubutunzi buhishe mu ngoro y'ibishushanyo bisengwa.
Numvise umuyobozi nakoreraga ategura umugambi wo kwica intumwa y'Imana, umugabo witwaga Musa.
Nabajije ku bwenge bwabo, mbibutsa iherezo ry'abantu ba Nuh, Ad, na Thamud.
Nabajije ikibazo gikomeye abantu banjye nti: 'Niba ari umubeshyi, ikinyoma cye kiri kuri we; ariko niba ari umunyakuri, bimwe mu byo asezeranya bizagukoraho.'
Inkuru yanjye ivugwa nk'urugero rw'ukwizera muri sura yitwa 'Ubabarira,' aho naburiye abantu banjye kwirinda imigambi y'abanyambaraga.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
